courses.title: ENVIRONMENTAL SCIENCE AND SUSTAINABILITY
courses.prereqText: Priority will be given to students in their first year at Western.

courses.title: ENVIRONMENT AND SUSTAINABILITY ON THE ISLAND OF IRELAND
courses.prereqText: Enrolment in the HON SPZ in One Health or a module offered by one of the following departments: Environmental Science, Biology, Chemistry, Earth Science, Integrated Science, Geography and Environment, Political Science, or permission of the instructor.

courses.title: FOUNDATIONS IN ENVIRONMENTAL SCIENCE
courses.prereqText: Environmental Science 1021F/G, or any 0.5 Earth Sciences course at the 1000 level, or registration in any module within the Faculty of Science or Schulich School of Medicine and Dentistry, or permission of the Department.

courses.title: ENVIRONMENTAL SCIENCE IN THE FIELD
courses.prereqText: Enrollment in any Environmental Science module, Honours Specialization in Integrated Science, or permission of the Department.

courses.title: RESEARCH TECHNIQUES IN ENVIRONMENTAL SCIENCE
courses.prereqText: Environmental Science 2300F/G or the former Environmental Science 3300F/G, or permission of the Department.

courses.title: SELECTED TOPICS IN ENVIRONMENTAL SCIENCE
courses.prereqText: Enrolment in the final year of the Honours Specialization or Specialization in Environmental Science.

courses.title: INDEPENDENT STUDY IN ENVIRONMENTAL SCIENCE
courses.prereqText: Enrolment in Year 4 of the Specialization or Major module in Environmental Science. Students must have arranged a project with a supervisor before completing registration.

courses.title: SENIOR THESIS
courses.prereqText: Registration in year 4 of an Honours Specialization offered by the Department of Earth Sciences, or permission of the Department.
